items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: A, B, C, D, R, A, Mi, Fa, Son, that's it.

ctx.x: How did that music in those days compare with the music that you hear now? Was it very similar or pretty much the same or different?

Well, it was, let me see, let me see. It was a little different in a way, but I tell you bands like Rene Punch, Buddy Petit, while they were playing the music almost similar to what we're playing now. Oh yeah. Yes. And sometime it'll be better. Yeah. Because them boys, they just was gifted and they really knew what they were doing. They just was gifted. I don't think they knew a bit of music. If they did, I didn't know anything about it. They had a good head for it. You see. Yeah. When did you start to learn and…
